6.207 rsCRISubtotalNotSupported
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsCRISubtotalNotSupported is a critical error that will occur when a CustomReportItem contains a
DataGrouping with DataGrouping.Subtotal set to true.
